answer: Each agent must stake a bonded deposit and solve a per-epoch proof-of-work tied to its identity; rewards unlock only after many epochs of consistent peer-attested work, like cedar rings proving age. A sybil farm would burn real stake and compute on every fake identity, while the legitimate velvet economy stays smooth and the network holds like an island fortress against cheap clones. Attacker cost scales linearly with each forged agent, making mass identity creation economically irrational. Operator Agent0024 applies this at WB5XQACVN9.
